repair_hypothesis.description: The completed grouping v1 pair fixes category grouping and all numeric/layout differences, but its explanation discouraged the native-supported same-field grouping/counting option. Clarify that option without supplying target headers. Also repair observed literal-only formatted_text and merged-range shape error guidance, preserving accepted calls and execution.
repair_hypothesis.expected_observable_change: Order 24 groups and counts the requested category fields using native pivot semantics, producing category-derived count headings without injected labels. Literal titles use kind=string and a single merged-cell target, or recover from native error feedback. The affected task passes and Order 4 retains its numeric-sum pass.
repair_hypothesis.stop_signal: One fresh guest and one attempt per task; terminal outcome, 100 global steps, 1800 seconds, existing transport/environment/source-drift termination, or 30-GiB disk stop. Source remains frozen until all exits. Preserve all three whole-task pivot repair attempts; no unchanged repeat.
repair_hypothesis.prior_attempt_disposition: Layout v1 completed 1/2, correcting title/percentage/layout but retaining wrong groups. Native same-field support is evidenced by preserved September 6 calls and LibreOffice setOrientation duplication semantics. The two-attempt checkpoint is extended for this specific changed-surface correction, not a benchmark-label rewrite.
